program:
root = Stack([header, mainGrid, tabsView], 16)
header = Text("Account Balances", "heading")

accounts = Query("host_listAccounts", {}, [])
cashflow = Query("host_getCashflowInsights", {}, [])
cards = Query("host_listCards", {}, [])
spending = Query("host_getSpendingInsights", {}, [])

totalBalance = @Sum(accounts.balance)
accountCount = @Count(accounts)

mainGrid = Grid([summaryCard, accountsTableCard], 2, 16)

summaryCard = Surface([totalStat, countStat, cashflowChart], "Financial Summary")
totalStat = Stat("Total Balance", totalBalance, "money", null, "accent")
countStat = Stat("Active Accounts", accountCount, "number")
cashflowChart = BarChart(cashflow, "label", ["in", "out"], "money", false, false, 200)

accountsTableCard = Surface([accountsTable], "Accounts Overview")
accountsTable = DataTable(accounts, [nameCol, kindCol, maskCol, balanceCol], "balance desc")
nameCol = {key: "name", label: "Account Name"}
kindCol = {key: "kind", label: "Type", format: "label"}
maskCol = {key: "mask", label: "Account #"}
balanceCol = {key: "balance", label: "Balance", format: "money", align: "end"}

tabsView = Tabs([cardsTab, spendingTab])
cardsTab = {label: "Linked Cards", content: cardsSurface}
spendingTab = {label: "Spending Breakdown", content: spendingSurface}

cardsSurface = Surface([cardsList], "Cards")
cardsList = CardList(cards, "network", "type", [cardMaskCol, cardDesignCol], 2)
cardMaskCol = {key: "mask", label: "Card Number"}
cardDesignCol = {key: "design", label: "Card Design", format: "label"}

spendingSurface = Surface([spendingChart], "Category Spend")
spendingChart = DonutChart(spending, "category", "amount", "money", true, 220)
